name: Evidence Processing
description: Hashes, timestamps and parses a supplied file, extracts metadata, classifies it by discipline and indexes it for search.

inputs.label: Supplied by the 'Run with file' action

legal_notes: Public, passive sources only. Respect each source's terms and keep to targets you own or have a documented reason to examine.

example_output: Hash, size, import time, discipline, observation count and a preview; the file is searchable in the case.
